package runtime

import (
	"internal/task"
	"unsafe"
)

func hashmapStringGet(m unsafe.Pointer, key string, value unsafe.Pointer, size uintptr) bool { return false }

func stringConcat(x, y string) string { return x }

func alloc(size uintptr, layout unsafe.Pointer) unsafe.Pointer { return nil }

func nilPanic() { task.Pause() }

//go:linkname timeSleep fxtime.Sleep
func timeSleep(d int64) { task.Pause() }

//go:linkname callMain main.main
func callMain()

//export Reset_Handler
func main() { callMain() }

func wasmEntryCommand() { callMain() }

//export strlen
func strlen(p unsafe.Pointer) uintptr

//go:export memcmp
func memcmp(a, b unsafe.Pointer, n uintptr) int
